nodes.summary: The endpoints of the edges of `F`.
nodes.title: Endpoints of a finite edge set

nodes.summary: The event that there are at least two infinite open clusters.
nodes.title: Event of at least two infinite open clusters

nodes.summary: A measurable function with countable values that is invariant under all shifts is almost surely constant under an ergodic probability measure. See also Mathlib's `ErgodicSMul` and `aeconst_of_forall_preimage_smul_ae_eq`, which state ergodicity of a group action through a.e.-invariant sets.
nodes.title: Shift-invariant countably valued functions are a.s. constant under ergodicity

nodes.summary: The configuration obtained from `ω` by opening every edge of `F`.
nodes.title: Configuration with a finite edge set forced open

nodes.summary: Finite energy for opening edges: for every finite edge set `F`, the law of `forceOpenFinset F ω` is absolutely continuous with respect to `μ`.
nodes.title: Finite energy for opening finite edge sets

nodes.summary: The set of infinite open clusters of `ω`.
nodes.title: Set of infinite open clusters

nodes.summary: The one-arm event `crossingEvent d n` (the origin is connected to a site outside `box d (n - 1)`) is measurable.
nodes.title: Measurability of the one-arm event

nodes.summary: Configurations with exactly `k` infinite clusters in which opening `F` connects two distinct infinite clusters.
nodes.title: Configurations with $k$ infinite clusters, two merged by opening $F$

nodes.summary: The number of infinite clusters is almost surely constant (Newman–Schulman 1981) for any translation-ergodic probability measure on bond configurations of `ℤ^d`.
nodes.title: Number of infinite clusters is almost surely constant

nodes.summary: For an ergodic measure with `μ(N ≥ 2) = 0`, either a.s. `N = 0` or a.s. `N = 1`.
nodes.title: Zero or one infinite cluster, given ergodicity and $\mu(N \ge 2) = 0$

nodes.summary: The number `N(ω) ∈ ℕ∞` of infinite open clusters of `ω`.
nodes.title: Number of infinite open clusters

nodes.summary: The set of sites `x` in an infinite cluster that are the `Encodable`-least site of their cluster (one representative per infinite cluster).
nodes.title: Representative sites of the infinite clusters
Inverse translation of the open subgraph

nodes.summary: Translation by `g` as a graph homomorphism between the open subgraphs of `ω` and of its shift.
nodes.title: Translation of the open subgraph as a graph homomorphism

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
